symbols.name: debugRows
symbols.summary:
Walks a form along its definition and lists every field, group and list with its state.
`<ngu-form-debug>` renders this; tests and tools can use it directly.
symbols.signature: export declare function debugRows(form: FormDef<any, any>, message?: (error: ValidationError, def: LeafDef | undefined) => string): NguDebugRow[];

symbols.name: NguDebugRow
symbols.summary: One field, group or list in the debug panel, with its state.

members.name: path
members.description: Model path, with numbers for list rows: `items.0.sku`.

members.name: kind
members.description: `'field'`, `'list'`, or `'group'` for a nested object, including an object row of a list.

members.name: dirty
members.description: True once the user changed it, or a field inside it.

members.name: touched
members.description: True once the user left it or a field inside it, or after a submit attempt.

members.name: hidden
members.description: True while a `hidden` rule hides it or its parent.

members.name: pending
members.description: True while an async check runs on it, or on a field inside it.

symbols.name: NguFormDebug
symbols.summary:
Shows a form's model, state, unsaved changes and every error by path, for development.
Import it from `ngu-form/debug`, so production bundles never include it.

```html
<ngu-form [form]="signup" />
<ngu-form-debug [form]="signup" />
```

members.name: form
members.description: The form to show, as `defineForm` returns it: the one given to `<ngu-form>`.
